shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git log -3 --oneline && sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '115,170p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,190p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && rg '\"version\"|\"ajv\"' package-lock.json | head -12 && git diff origin/main -- package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts package.json package-lock.json CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts package.json package-lock.json CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Complete validator package metadata" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
